blurb: Westwind Helicopters provides helicopter services including oil and gas operations, lightering services, and utilities operations such as power line and pipeline patrols. They operate a fleet including Bell 206, Bell 407, and Sikorsky S-76 helicopters. Their bases are located in Santa Fe, TX, Abbeville, LA, and Houma, LA, serving the US Gulf Coast region.
